gbm_population_evidence.quote: Adult patients with recurrent IDHwt glioblastoma

candidate_evidence.quote: [OTHER] plasma collection: Plasma samples will be prospectively collected at relevant time points during patient treatment.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Relapse after standard first line treatment (radio-chemotherapy)

role_evidence.quote: Now, the investigators objective is to prospectively monitor the soluble CD146 value in plasma from patients treated by bevacizumab for recurrent glioblastoma.

source_quote.quote: correlation between soluble CD146 plasma value and patient response (RANO): Soluble CD146 plasma value will be assessed using ELISA.
Adult patients with recurrent IDHwt glioblastoma

coder_notes: Observational-style biomarker study (phase NA); only registered intervention is plasma collection. Bevacizumab is not a registered intervention but all patients are treated with it as standard care for recurrent GBM; listed as soc_backbone (not investigated in a new schedule). No candidate. Soluble CD146 is a plasma marker hypothesised to predict bevacizumab resistance; recorded as exploratory correlative. IDH-wildtype listed as diagnostic eligibility criterion.
